name: Animated Beam Connector
description: An animated gradient pulse that travels along a curved SVG path connecting two referenced DOM nodes, ideal for integration and architecture diagrams.
usage: Give a relative container a ref, give each node you want to wire its own ref, then render one <AnimatedBeam containerRef fromRef toRef /> per connection; tune curvature, reverse, duration, delay and the gradient colours, and the path auto-recomputes on resize via a ResizeObserver.
